services:
  frontend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: task-dashboard/Dockerfile
      args:
        VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:4000
    ports:
      - "3000:80"
    depends_on:
      - backend

  backend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: backend/Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "4000:4000"
    environment:
      PORT: 4000
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@db:5432/task_dash?schema=public
      JWT_SECRET: your-secret-key-change-in-production
    depends_on:
      - db

  db:
    image: postgres:16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: task_dash
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

volumes:
  postgres_data:
